mapper.insert: insert into wo_action_log (order_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, action_content, ext_json, idempotency_key, action_time) values (#{orderId}, #{actionType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorRole}, #{actionContent}, cast(#{extJson} as json), #{idempotencyKey}, #{actionTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, action_content, cast(ext_json as char) ext_json, idempotency_key, action_time from wo_action_log where operator_id = #{operatorId} and action_type = #{actionType} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select id, order_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, action_content, cast(ext_json as char) ext_json, idempotency_key, action_time from wo_action_log where order_id = #{orderId} order by action_time, id
